title: The git-maintenance control fixtures self-invalidate on a host whose git runs no background maintenance
body: internal/reconcile TestTheHarnessStartsNoGitItDoesNotWaitFor and internal/gitbin TestAnAgentsCommitStartsNoMaintenance both t.Fatal when their CONTROL run (plain unpinned git) starts no background maintenance, which is this host's condition — so the gate is red at base here. This is the exact shape the repo's own learnings warn about ("a gate verdict is about the tree only if the host is bounded"): the fixtures measure the host's git, not the tree.
